name: TermiX
steps: Open agent.family/points and pick a chain at the top (BNB Chain is the default). Points are tracked per chain.

Sign in with a self-custodial wallet. The docs say sign-in is a signed message: "Authentication is a two-step EIP-191 flow: request a nonce, sign it, exchange the signature for a session." Keep a little BNB or ETH for gas.
Do the one-time tasks: bind X and follow @termix_ai (500), then join and verify Discord (500).
Register a client agent through the onboarding page (200) and, if you like, a provider agent (200). Registering mints an on-chain identity, so you pay gas.
Each day, submit up to 2 of your own X posts that mention TermiX or agent.family. Posts with no engagement score nothing.
what: TermiX promises tokens only to ranked X creators in its Kaito campaign, paid at a TGE with no date. Season 1 points have no stated value.
behind: TermiX names no founders, team members or company on its sites. Its X profile says "Backed by @yzilabs", and a TermiX X article from 15 May 2026 says YZi Labs "invested in TermiX's $1M seed round in May 2025". We found no named news outlet confirming that round. Code and the whitepaper are on GitHub under TermiX-official. The project also says it won a BNB Chain hackathon, which we haven't checked
costs: The social tasks are free apart from gas for registering agents. Job points need real paid jobs in USDC or USDT, and every settled job pays a fee; the app lists protocol revenue as "2% of total volume". The paid promos cost $1, 15 USDC, 30 USDC or 31.5 USDC. Providers who take bounty slots lock a bond, and "Slashing is capped at the amount actually locked for that order or slot". Opening a dispute
risks: No terms of service, privacy policy or legal entity. The terms and privacy links on agent.family return errors, so there is no written list of excluded countries, age limit or KYC rule. No audit is published. The whitepaper says "All contracts will undergo third-party audit before mainnet deployment.", yet escrow contracts already hold user payments on BNB Chain and Base.
